<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in;"><span style="color: #333333; font-family: Noto Sans CJK SC Regular; font-size: x-large;"><span lang="zh-CN"><b>围魏救赵</b></span></span></p>

<p class="western" style="font-size: 1.2em; font-weight: normal; line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;">
<span style="color: #333333; font-family: Liberation Serif, Times New Roman, serif;"><span style="font-size: 1.2em;"><i>Besiege
Wei to Rescue Zhao</i></span></span></p>
<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;">
<span style="color: #333333;"><br /></span>

</p>


	
	
	
	

<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in;">
<span style="font-family: inherit; font-size: large;"><span style="color: #333333;">Sun Bin (<span><span lang="zh-CN">孙膑</span></span>,
died 316 B.C.) was an advisor to the Kingdom of Wei during the
Warring States Period (475-221 B.C.), and descendant of Sun Tzu (<span><span lang="zh-CN">孙子</span></span>,
544-496 B.C.), the author of <i>The Art of War</i>. He had fallen
under the designs of the envious Pang Juan (<span><span lang="zh-CN">庞涓</span></span>,
died 342 B.C.), chief military advisor to Wei, who tampered with a
letter to make it seem as though Sun Bin had plans to defect. After
enduring harsh punishment, Sun Bin was eventually saved by people
from the State of Qi. Pang Juan was sent some years later to attack
the State of Zhao, and Zhao subsequently went to Qi for aid. 
</span></span></p>
<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;">
<span style="color: #333333; font-family: inherit; font-size: large;">	<span><span lang="en-US">The
phrase ‘Besiege Wei to Rescue Zhao’ refers to the following year,
the entirety of which Wei's forces were weakened under a siege lead
by Sun Bin, and after which Sun Bin coordinated an attack on Wei's
capital. Pang Juan took the bait, and tried rushing back with 20,000
troops, but was assailed from behind by Zhao forces, and then
decimated by an ambush led by Sun Bin </span></span><span><span lang="en-US">[17],
[</span></span><span><span lang="en-US">29</span></span><span><span lang="en-US">]</span></span><span><span lang="en-US">.</span></span></span></p>
<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;">
<span style="color: #333333; font-family: inherit; font-size: large;"><span><span lang="en-US"><i>Besiege
Wei to Rescue Zhao</i></span></span><span><span lang="en-US">
is associated with 53rd hexagram, </span></span><span><span lang="en-US"><i>Wind
over Mountain</i></span></span><span><span lang="en-US">.
Do not move forward in haste, but use the immovability of the
Mountain together with Wind's penetrating force to discern the most
opportune time and place to act</span></span><span><span lang="en-US">
</span></span><span><span lang="en-US">[1],
[28]</span></span><span><span lang="en-US">.</span></span></span></p><p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;"><span style="color: #333333; font-family: inherit; font-size: large;"><span><span lang="en-US">&nbsp;</span></span></span></p><p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;">

<div dir="ltr" id="Section13" style="column-count: 2;"><p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in;">
	<span style="color: #333333; font-family: inherit; font-size: large; text-decoration: none;">to listen:
	<span lang="zh-CN">听</span>:
	t</span><span style="color: #333333; font-family: inherit; font-size: large;">īng  
	</span></p>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in;"><span style="color: #0047AB !important; font-family: inherit; font-size: large;">to surround:<span style="text-decoration: none;">&nbsp;<span style="color: #0047AB !important;" lang="zh-CN">围:
	wéi</span></span></p>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in;"><span style="color: #333333; font-family: inherit; font-size: large;">seems:
	<span lang="zh-CN">似乎</span>:
	sì hū   
	</span></p>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in;"><span style="color: #333333; font-family: inherit; font-size: large;">or:
	<span lang="zh-CN">或者</span>/<span lang="zh-CN">还是</span>:
	huòzhě/háishì   
	</span></p>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in;"><span style="color: #333333; font-family: inherit; font-size: large;">while:
	<span lang="zh-CN">当</span>...<span lang="zh-CN">的时候</span>:
	dāng...de shíhòu   
	</span></p>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in;"><span style="color: #0047AB !important; font-family: inherit; font-size: large;">to save/to rescue: <span style="text-decoration: none;"><span style="color: #0047AB !important;" lang="zh-CN">救:
	jiù</span></span></p>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in;"><span style="color: #333333; font-family: inherit; font-size: large;">only:
	<span lang="zh-CN">只</span>:
	zhǐ   
	</span></p>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in;"><span style="color: #333333; font-family: inherit; font-size: large;">more:
	<span lang="zh-CN">更</span>/<span lang="zh-CN">更多</span>:
	gèng/gèng duō</span></p>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in;"><span style="color: #333333; font-family: inherit; font-size: large;">already:
	<span lang="zh-CN">已经</span>:
	yǐjīng   
	</span></p>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in;"><span style="color: #333333; font-family: inherit; font-size: large;">there
	is: <span lang="zh-CN">有</span>:
	yǒu   
	</span></p>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in;"><span style="color: #333333; font-family: inherit; font-size: large;">wood:
	<span lang="zh-CN">木头</span>:
	mùtou   
	</span></p>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in;"><span style="color: #333333; font-family: inherit; font-size: large;">there
	is not/no: <span lang="zh-CN">没有</span>:
	méiyǒu</span></p>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in;"><span style="color: #333333; font-family: inherit; font-size: large;">to
	rest: <span lang="zh-CN">休息</span>:
	xiūxí   
	</span></p>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in;"><span style="color: #333333; font-family: inherit; font-size: large;">forest/woods:
	<span lang="zh-CN">森林</span>:
	sēnlín  
	</span></p>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in;"><span style="color: #333333; font-family: inherit; font-size: large;">time:
	<span lang="zh-CN">时候</span>:
	 shíhòu</span></p>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in;"><span style="color: #333333; font-family: inherit; font-size: large;">sometimes:
	<span lang="zh-CN">有时</span>/<span lang="zh-CN">有的时候</span>:
	yǒushí/yǒu de shíhòu   
	</span></p>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in;"><span style="color: #333333; font-family: inherit; font-size: large;">about:
	<span lang="zh-CN">关于</span>:
	guānyú</span></p>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in;"><span style="color: #333333; font-family: inherit; font-size: large;">should:
	<span lang="zh-CN">应该</span>:
	yīnggāi 
	</span></p>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in;"><span style="color: #0047AB !important; font-family: inherit; font-size: large;">Sun <span style="color: #0047AB !important;">(e.g. Sun Tzu): 孙:
	sūn</span></span></p>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in;"><span style="color: #0047AB !important; font-family: inherit; font-size: large;">Zhao (e.g. State of Zhao): <span style="color: #0047AB !important;" lang="zh-CN">赵:
	zhào</span></span></p>

	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in;"><span style="color: #333333; font-family: inherit; font-size: large;"><a name="tw-source-rmn21"></a>

	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in;"><span style="color: #333333; font-family: inherit; font-size: large;">to

	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in;"><span style="color: #333333; font-family: inherit; font-size: large;">time:

	</span><span style="text-decoration: none;">s</span><span style="text-decoration: none;">híjiān</span></span></p>

<div dir="ltr" id="Section55" style="column-count: 2;"><p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;"><span style="color: #333333;">
	<span style="font-size: large;">1) <span style="font-family: Noto Sans CJK SC Regular;"><span lang="zh-CN">当我在跑步的时候我喜欢听音乐。</span></span></span></span></p>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;">
	<span style="color: #333333; font-size: small;">Trans.: When I’m running, I
	like to listen to music.</span></p>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;">
	<span style="font-size: large;"><span style="color: #333333;"><br /></span></span>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;"><span style="font-size: large;"><span style="color: #333333;">
	1) <span style="font-family: Noto Sans CJK SC Regular;"><span lang="zh-CN">他有时在那棵树下休息。</span></span></span></span></p>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;">
	<span style="color: #333333; font-size: medium;">Trans.: He is always resting
	under that tree.</span></p>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;">
	<span style="font-size: large;"><span style="color: #333333;"><br /></span></span>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;"><span style="font-size: large;"><span style="color: #333333;">
	2) <span style="font-family: Noto Sans CJK SC Regular;"><span lang="zh-CN">我没有时间。</span></span></span></span></p>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;">
	<span style="font-size: large;"><span style="color: #333333;"><br /></span></span>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;"><span style="font-size: large;"><span style="color: #333333;">
	3) <span style="font-family: Noto Sans CJK SC Regular;"><span lang="zh-CN">需不需要买木头的桌子和椅子？</span></span></span></span></p>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;">
	<span style="font-size: large;"><span style="color: #333333;"><br /></span></span>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;"><span style="font-size: large;"><span style="color: #333333;">
	4) <span style="font-family: Noto Sans CJK SC Regular;"><span lang="zh-CN">我们应该去森林里走一会。</span></span></span></span></p>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;">
	<span style="font-size: large;"><span style="color: #333333;"><br /></span></span>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in;"><span style="font-size: large;"><span style="color: #333333;"><span lang="en-US"><span style="text-decoration: none;">6</span></span>) </span><span style="color: #0047AB !important;"><span style="font-family: times; color: #0047AB !important;">他救了小女孩的狗。</span></span></span></p>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in;"><span style="font-size: large;"><span style="color: #333333;"><br /></span></span>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in;"><span style="font-size: large;"><span style="color: #333333;"><span lang="en-US"><span style="text-decoration: none;">7</span></span>) </span><span style="color: #0047AB !important;"><span style="font-family: times; color: #0047AB !important;">小孩们围在那里买橙汁。</span></span></span></p>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;">
	<span style="font-size: large;"><span style="color: #333333;"><br /></span></span>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;"><span style="font-size: large;"><span style="color: #333333;">
	5) <span style="font-family: Noto Sans CJK SC Regular;"><span lang="zh-CN">关于这个，我不太知道。</span></span></span></span></p>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;">
	<span style="font-size: large;"><span style="color: #333333;"><br /></span></span>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;"><span style="font-size: large;"><span style="color: #333333;">
	6) <span style="font-family: Noto Sans CJK SC Regular;"><span lang="zh-CN">你为什么下车？你需要去小店吗？</span></span></span></span></p>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;">
	<span style="font-size: large;"><span style="color: #333333;"><br /></span></span>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;"><span style="font-size: large;"><span style="color: #333333;">
	7)  <span style="font-family: Noto Sans CJK SC Regular;"><span lang="zh-CN">哪一个小店？</span></span></span></span></p>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;">
	<span style="font-size: large;"><span style="color: #333333;"><br /></span></span>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;"><span style="font-size: large;"><span style="color: #333333;">
	8)  <span style="font-family: Noto Sans CJK SC Regular;"><span lang="zh-CN">只有一个小店。</span></span></span></span></p>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;">
	<span style="font-size: large;"><span style="color: #333333;"><br /></span></span>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;"><span style="font-size: large;"><span style="color: #333333;">
	9)  <span style="font-family: Noto Sans CJK SC Regular;"><span lang="zh-CN">那扇窗户似乎太小了。</span></span></span></span></p>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;">
	<span style="font-size: large;"><span style="color: #333333;"><br /></span></span>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;"><span style="font-size: large;"><span style="color: #333333;">
	10) Q: <span style="font-family: Noto Sans CJK SC Regular;"><span lang="zh-CN">猫在哪？</span></span></span></span></p>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;">
	<span style="font-size: large;"><span style="color: #333333;"><br /></span></span>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in;"><span style="font-size: large;"><span style="color: #333333; text-decoration: none;">&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp; </span><span style="color: #333333; text-decoration: none;">A:
	<span style="font-family: Noto Sans CJK SC Regular;"><span lang="zh-CN">在椅子下。</span></span></span></span></p>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;">
	<span style="font-size: large;"><span style="color: #333333;"><br /></span></span>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;"><span style="font-size: large;"><span style="color: #333333;">
	11) <span style="font-family: Noto Sans CJK SC Regular;"><span lang="zh-CN">我们要更多香蕉。</span></span></span></span></p>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;">
	<span style="font-size: large;"><span style="color: #333333;"><br /></span></span>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;"><span style="font-size: large;"><span style="color: #333333;"><a name="tw-source-rmn32"></a>
	12) <span style="font-family: Noto Sans CJK SC Regular;"><span lang="zh-CN">我已经买了很多香蕉。</span></span></span></span></p>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;">
	<span style="font-size: large;"><span style="color: #333333;"><br /></span></span>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;"><span style="font-size: large;"><span style="color: #333333;">
	13) Q: <span style="font-family: Noto Sans CJK SC Regular;"><span lang="zh-CN">好的。它们在哪？</span></span></span></span></p>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;">
	<span style="font-size: large;"><span style="color: #333333;"><br /></span></span>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in;"><span style="font-size: large;"><span style="color: #333333; text-decoration: none;">&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp; </span><span style="color: #333333; text-decoration: none;">A:
	<span style="font-family: Noto Sans CJK SC Regular;"><span lang="zh-CN">在桌子上。</span></span></span></span></p>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;">
	<span style="font-size: large;"><span style="color: #333333;"><br /></span></span>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;">
	<span face="Noto Sans CJK SC Black, sans-serif" style="color: #333333; font-size: large;"><span style="font-family: Liberation Serif, Times New Roman, serif;"><span lang="en-US">1</span></span><span style="font-family: Liberation Serif, Times New Roman, serif;"><span lang="en-US">7</span></span><span style="font-family: Liberation Serif, Times New Roman, serif;"><span lang="en-US">)</span></span>
	</span><span style="color: #333333; font-family: Noto Sans CJK SC Regular; font-size: large;"><span lang="zh-CN">三号门怎么走？</span></span></p>
</div>
<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in;"><span style="color: #333333;"><br /></span>

</p>
<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;"><span style="color: #333333;">
-------------------------------------</span></p>
